🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 18, 2026

Moon, in Pisces, holds a trine to Mercury, in Scorpio. Both in water, and speaking the same dialect: the worth of a thing and the account of it briefly coincide.

Easier — Reviewing, sorting, naming what a thing is worth to you.
Harder — Mistaking an easy day for a free one.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. Venus in Libra stands opposite, and what you value is quoted back. Cardinal fire meets a bill. Three weeks ago Mars was still held by Mercury; that is finished.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you from its own Libra. From Pisces, Moon offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Earth keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. Unchanged for four weeks: you know what it asks.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon squares you from Pisces: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Air bends, and each bend is invoiced. The conjunction to Sun that held two weeks ago has let go.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, is only passing through Pisces. Mercury in Scorpio trines you: agreement arrives before the argument. Water begins, and beginning asks little today. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you and passes through Scorpio as a guest. From Scorpio, Mercury cuts across the appetite. Fire holds on, and the holding is billed. Sun left Libra four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. From Pisces, Moon quotes your worth back at you. Mutable earth: keeping options is the expense. Forward again for a week now, Mercury has left the old ground.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you from its own Libra: no permission needed. Mars in Leo opens a gap you have to step into. Cardinal air opens the account without argument. Venus has not been in Scorpio for four weeks.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you from Leo, where nothing is owed to it. From Pisces, Moon concedes the point early. Water keeps what it has, cheaply. In four weeks Mars has moved 14°, small enough to feel like nothing.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Moon squares you from Pisces, and the cost objects. Mutable fire: every option kept is an option paid for. The square of three weeks ago is off it now.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Moon in Pisces leaves a door ajar; nothing walks through it alone. Earth moves first here, and first is enough. It has stood four weeks; by now the cost is known.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Retrograde: the accounting runs backwards first. From Scorpio, Mercury sets a figure against the wanting. Fixed air pays to hold on. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Water changes shape until there is only one shape. This is days old, not weeks, and behaves like it.
